ctx.x: Well, organ groups and piano players are the cause of me playin' without one as far as today is concerned. Because I made myself adept a system that I don't need piano or organ, cause they like drove me out of my mind. With my own organ. I paid $3,000 and some dollars for an organ. My organ and I gotta find somebody to play it. And they guys -- whoever could play it they gave me a hard time. Plus I got to cart this thing around. I'd have a trailer. And -- the thing ran off, get loose a couple of times -- boy, it…

why don't you turn that thing down a little? Then the piano players, they overload their chords. They get two hands, so they try to make two hands, and if it was possible they would put one of their feet up there to make extra notes. They got so many notes there's no room for nobody else, especially me. So, but it's beautiful guys that play man, like Hank Jones, Ray Bryant, and I mean, lot a guys that could play and keep out of each other's way and when your time comes you can do whatever you want to.
